title: helm(private): improve values schema, init hooks and upgrade/rollback compatibility
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: Private deployments require predictable upgrades and safe rollbacks. The existing Helm chart occasionally re-applies templates during rollbacks which can lead to init job races and stale config values. This PR: 1) expands values.schema.json with explicit nullable/required fields and clearer defaulting rules, 2) makes init jobs idempotent and leader-aware (prevents multiple inits during rolling upgrades), 3) introduces helm hook ordering and lifecycle annotations to ensure predictable pre-upgrade/pre-rollback behavior, 4) adapts templates to avoid forcing ConfigMap updates when only chart metadata changes, 5) adds a small migration step to reconcile legacy values (used by earlier private installs), and 6) adds an automated upgrade/rollback integration test script. Implementation notes: - values.schema.json: added top-level `private.networking` and `private.storage` schemas with proper type/nullable handling; validated against default values. - init-job.yaml: switched to a short leader-election loop (configmap-based) and explicit idempotent checks (check for marker file in PVC or a release annotation), added backoff for transient errors. - hooks: introduced pre-upgrade and pre-rollback Helm hooks with explicit `helm.sh/hook-weight` ordering and `helm.sh/hook-delete-policy` set to `hook-succeeded`. - templating: configmap and secret templates now include chart.metadata.revision-based annotations to avoid accidental restarts; we only bump when relevant values change. - tests: added scripts/helm-tests/upgrade-rollback.sh to run a simulated in-cluster upgrade+rollback with the init hook present. Backwards compatibility: added migration logic for legacy private.* keys while keeping old keys supported for one release cycle. Rollback compatibility: hooks are guarded so rollbacks do not re-run destructive migration steps. See commits and file list for details.

review_comments: Ben Gould: Can the init job be made tolerant of concurrent runs during a canary? Suggest adding a leader election / single-writer mutex. (requested changes)
Maya Chen: Reply: added a simple configmap-based leader election and idempotent marker check; details in init-job.yaml. Also added backoff/retry to reduce thundering herd.
Priya Desai: Note: please ensure hooks don't run during dry-run upgrades; also add a test for rollback path. (requested changes)
Maya Chen: Reply: hooks have explicit weights and delete-policy; added upgrade-rollback.sh which simulates dry-run + real rollback in CI.

release_notes:
- Improved values schema for redwood-private with clearer networking/storage defaults.
- Init job made idempotent and leader-aware to avoid races during upgrades.
- Added pre-upgrade and pre-rollback Helm hooks with explicit ordering and safe delete policies.
- Migration logic for legacy private values and a one-release compatibility window.
- Upgrade/rollback integration test script added to CI.
notes_for_ops: Operators: when upgrading, monitor init-job logs for leader-election and marker writes; if you roll back, migration steps are guarded but monitor PVC markers. Chart version bump ensures Helm reconciles only when values change.
